{"content":"how much could we simplify if we ignore cross window issues","assessment":"how much could we simplify if we ignore cross window issues","recommendation":"change","appliedSummary":"**About 250–275 production lines and 920 test lines could go**, including comments and blank lines, if we stop supporting overlapping editors for the same event.

The queue also handles separate tabs in one window. The full reduction therefore needs a broader assumption than ignoring separate windows.

The main reductions would be:

- Remove [CalendarEventEdit.sys.mjs](/Users/aschmitz/projects/fox/comm/mail/components/calendar/modules/CalendarEventEdit.sys.mjs): **233 lines**. This removes shared save ordering, calendar identity tracking, and updates to queued occurrence IDs after series changes.
- Simplify [calendar-event-edit-save.mjs](/Users/aschmitz/projects/fox/comm/mail/components/calendar/content/calendar-event-edit-save.mjs): approximately **20–40 lines**. Save could load the event and execute the transaction directly.
- Remove nine unit tests and one browser test for overlapping editors: **920 lines**.

The largest reduction would be under `mail/components/calendar/`. The shared `calendar/` code still needs failed-move recovery and failed-transaction removal from Undo. Those failures can occur with one editor.

I would also retain duplicate-Save blocking, draft retention, permission checks, and checks for an old operation completing after draft replacement. Storage revision checks protect changes from synchronization and other actions too.

These are source estimates. I changed no files.","changeSummary":"Make the changes requested by the author.","state":"handled","changeAccepted":false,"changeReverted":false}
